scope.claimLimit: QA spatial review geometry only. This fixture does not create business identity, tenant frontage, storefront anchor, exact address, entrance, signage, material, active-status, production, or public/product claims.

rootCauseDiagnosis.symptom: R10C/R10D labels were in correct quadrants, but the Visual POC/4L target building bodies did not read as the Franklin x Greenpoint three-corner condition.
rootCauseDiagnosis.likelyRootCause: The runtime building bodies use the long Greenpoint corridor preview transform, not the Franklin-local map-truth frame.
rootCauseDiagnosis.proposedFix: Add a QA-only Franklin Scene Truth layer that renders the target building bodies from source WGS84 footprints in the Franklin-local street frame and hides the conflicting stylized corridor bodies in that focus.
rootCauseDiagnosis.verifierOrScreenshotProof: R10E verifier checks runtime snippets and screenshot artifacts; top-down R10E screenshot must show bodies, not only labels.

rootCauseDiagnosis.symptom: Premier/Franklin Organic and Sonny's render close together on the same corridor-side band in the old scene, while Sereneco appears as a far-left corridor object instead of directly across Greenpoint.
rootCauseDiagnosis.likelyRootCause: The corridor transform compresses perpendicular street depth and aligns the preview around Greenpoint's centerline only.
rootCauseDiagnosis.proposedFix: Use the shared Greenpoint/Franklin endpoint and WGS84 footprint polygons to project the three target bodies into a local Franklin review scene.
rootCauseDiagnosis.verifierOrScreenshotProof: Verifier compares WGS side classification and projected scene position for all target BINs.

rootCauseDiagnosis.symptom: Franklin Ave was represented by QA labels/slabs but did not control the actual target building placement.
rootCauseDiagnosis.likelyRootCause: The Phase 3B source packet includes Greenpoint centerline segments but no Franklin Ave centerline; R10B/R10C derived a separator after the runtime scene was already built.
rootCauseDiagnosis.proposedFix: Keep Franklin as an explicitly bounded QA-only derived cross-street slab through the shared Greenpoint endpoint, and use that same slab as the placement control in Franklin Scene Truth mode.
rootCauseDiagnosis.verifierOrScreenshotProof: Verifier fails unless Franklin and Greenpoint slabs are required scene control geometry and the Franklin centerline gap is recorded.

rootCauseDiagnosis.symptom: Centroid-only checks passed but storefront/frontage readability failed.
rootCauseDiagnosis.likelyRootCause: Prior verifier checked side of Franklin and Greenpoint from centroid only, not the street-facing footprint edge.
rootCauseDiagnosis.proposedFix: Add frontage-aware validation using the footprint edge nearest the Greenpoint street axis and require compact frontage edge highlights in the QA scene.
rootCauseDiagnosis.verifierOrScreenshotProof: R10E verifier checks each target frontageStreet, frontageFacing, nearest-edge method, and runtime frontage highlight support.

sceneTruthModel.mappingDecision: Target BINs remain preserved. The issue was not source identity; it was the runtime scene transform and centroid-only validation.

successCriteria: Franklin Ave crosses Greenpoint Ave in the correct place.
Sereneco and Premier / Franklin Organic are on opposite sides of Greenpoint Ave.
Sereneco and Premier / Franklin Organic are both west/across Franklin.
Sonny's Corner is east/corridor-side of Franklin and south of Greenpoint.
The three building bodies form a real three-corner intersection relationship.
The storefront/frontage edges face the correct streets.
Building positions come from GIS/map reconciliation, not manual visual offsets.
The scene remains readable with labels turned down or removed.
The verifier fails if any target is assigned to the wrong side, wrong frontage, or wrong scene position.
Batu can identify which building is which from the scene without opening Google Maps.
